messages:
ana-finance: Quick question — AcmeHealth (private VPC) is asking us to 'rebill' them net of our reserved cloud commitments and also apply a pro-rated license credit for unused dedicated slots. They want a single invoice showing their VM/GPU pass-through at discounted rate and a license line item offset. Is that something finance supports?

mike-eng-infra: We can export GPU-hours + SKU tags from our metering, but two caveats: 1) reservations apply at account level and may not map 1:1 to customer tags; 2) reserved instance amortization math depends on the billing period and any early termination.

ana-finance: @mike-eng-infra good point. Do we currently have a deterministic algorithm to apportion reservation savings to tenant-tagged usage? Or do we only do post-hoc reconciliation?

mike-eng-infra: We only have post-hoc reconciliation today. The metering pipeline emits per-node tags and GPU-hours. Allocation script (in deploy infra) runs monthly and writes an allocation CSV. It looks like: 
```
customer_id,node_id,gpu_hours,allocated_reserved_hours,reservation_owner
ACME-001,node-337,420,300,shared-res-v4
```
We could add a forecasted monthly commit split but would need legal sign-off to push that as an invoice line.

sara-cs: The customer contract language is ambiguous: they committed to an annual seat/reserve but expect the license fee to drop if they consume fewer reserved hours. They're asking for a "reservation-offset" credit each month. Legal wants an explicit amortization table in the SOW.

oliver-sales: From sales' side, we can offer two options: 1) Monthly pass-through invoice where we bill actual usage + a separate amortized reservation charge (positive or negative) to reconcile; 2) Fixed commitment invoice with quarterly true-up. Customer prefers option 1 (transparent), but ops wants to ensure we don't expose internal discounts details.

ana-finance: We need a little matrix: what line items we can show to the customer without exposing our cloud discount rates. Ideally customer sees "Cloud GPU (pass-through) — net rate" and "Redwood license — monthly amortization". We should avoid exposing our reserved purchase price and discount percent.

mike-eng-infra: Technically we can compute an "effective unit rate" per GPU-hour after reservation allocation and show that as the net pass-through rate. Backend can generate: 
```
line_item: GPU pass-through (net)
unit_rate: $X.XX per GPU-hour
units: 420
amount: $XXX.XX
```
We'd keep the reserved purchase price internal and only show the derived net rate.

billing-bot: Invoice draft generated for ACME-001 (preview):
```
1) GPU pass-through (net rate) — 420 hours @ $2.25 = $945.00
2) Reserved amortization credit — -$150.00
3) Redwood license (monthly) — $2,000.00
Total due: $2,795.00
```

ana-finance: That format looks plausible. A few follow-ups: how do we handle refunds if reservation math is corrected later? Do we do adjustments on the next invoice or issue credit memos?

mike-eng-infra: We currently issue credit memos for corrections > $50; smaller deltas roll into the next invoice. We'll need to document this policy in the SOW.

oliver-sales: Also confirm: for on-prem private deployments where customer provides hardware but we still license software — license-only invoices should stay unchanged. This case is specifically where we manage cloud infra and want to rebill net of reserved capacity.

sara-cs: I'll ask Legal to draft SOW language for amortization schedule and reconciliation timeline. Finance: can you prepare a sample 6-month amortization table showing applied reservation offsets and the resulting net pass-through rates? Customer wants it by EOW.

ana-finance: On it. Mike — can you export last 6 months of allocation CSVs and expected reservation coverage percentage so we can build that table?

mike-eng-infra: Will do. Exporting now; will push to secure bucket and ping here when ready. ETA 24 hours. :thumbsup:

oliver-sales: FYI, Acme negotiated an NDA clause that forbids disclosing our vendor discounts. The approach above (net unit rate) should satisfy that.

ana-finance: Great. Action items: 1) @mike-eng-infra export allocations and reservation coverage (24h) 2) @ana-finance (me) build amortization + invoice samples (EOW) 3) @sara-cs request SOW/contract language from Legal. If anything else, post updates here.

billing-bot: Note: automated invoice previews will append an internal-only comment with 'reservation_id' and 'allocation_hash' for audit. Those are not included on customer-facing PDFs.

sara-cs: Thanks everyone. Will loop Legal in and keep customer expectation aligned.

ana-finance: Closing thread once we upload the amortization table.
